headline: Board to vote on FY26 Budget Resolution, Multilingual Coordinators contract ratification, and first read of Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan.
summary: The meeting covers personnel actions, committee reports, updates on school culture, High School for the Future, and Middle School Design, plus votes on the FY2026 Budget Update and Multilingual Coordinators contract. The board will also do a first read of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan and enter Executive Session to discuss a personnel matter.
